subject: Request: Demo with engineering leads — timezone check and preferred slots
messages:
From: Michelle Tran <michelle@oakridgehealth.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: oakridge-sales@oakridgehealth.com
Date: 2026-09-15T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Demo with engineering leads — timezone check and preferred slots

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick reply on the trial — Oakridge is excited to see Redwood in action. We need a 60-minute demo for our product/ops + engineering leads to validate integration for an October 30 launch window. Our execs are in NYC (EDT) and our infra/engineering lead is in Boston, but we also asked our EU partner team (based in Berlin) to join so they can sign off on E2E tests.

Quick note on availability: our execs prefer mornings Eastern (9:00–12:00 EDT). That maps to very late for Berlin (15:00–18:00 CEST). The Redwood rep I spoke to suggested a host from the EU engineering team — is that possible? If necessary we can do an evening slot on our side (after 17:00 EDT) but that gets late for EU participants.

Proposed slots (what we threw together):
- Thu Sep 17 — 09:30 EDT / 15:30 CEST
- Fri Sep 18 — 11:00 EDT / 17:00 CEST

If those are impossible for EU presence, can you point to two alternates where an EU engineer can realistically attend (no later than 18:00 CEST)? Also please record the session.

Attachments: I attached our high-level evaluation checklist (see mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

Best,
Michelle Tran
Senior PM, Oakridge Health
michelle@oakridgehealth.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Michelle Tran <michelle@oakridgehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-16T08:11:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Demo with engineering leads — timezone check and preferred slots

Hi Michelle —

Appreciate the checklist and context. We can definitely include an EU-based engineer on the call; Kimberly (cc'd) typically hosts cross-region deep dives with customers. A couple of practical options that keep Berlin participants within work hours (CEST):

- Option A: 07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT / 17:00 CEST (shorter early start for West Coast)
- Option B: 08:30 PDT / 11:30 EDT / 18:30 CEST (later for EU — borderline)
- Option C: 09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT / 19:00 CEST (we'd avoid this for Berlin)

Given your exec preference for mornings Eastern, Option B (11:30 EDT / 18:30 CEST) fits the exec window but pushes Berlin to 18:30. If Kimberly can stay until 18:30 CEST it's feasible.

One scheduling gotcha to flag: DST changes in late October/early November are not aligned between the US and EU this year — EU clocks go back the last Sunday in October and the US the first Sunday in November. If you plan to book anything in late Oct vs early Nov, we'll add explicit UTC times and both local times in invites to avoid the usual off-by-one-hour confusion.

I'm free to rotate hosts; if you'd like Kimberly to lead the engineer-facing portion, she can do the deep-dive segment and we can have aditya join for product/setup questions.

I'll leave the final slot choice to you — once you confirm we'll send an invite with an explicit UTC timestamp and record.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: Demo with engineering leads — timezone check and preferred slots

Hi Michelle —

I can host from Berlin and stay on the call until 18:30 CEST if that helps. Practically, here's what I propose so nobody is burned out:

- Demo length: 60 minutes (we'll reserve 75 minutes in calendar to allow for overruns)
- Agenda split: 20m overview (Diego), 25m engineering deep-dive (me), 15m Q&A + next steps (Aditya)
- Recording: yes — we'll upload to the HubSpot deal and share the link afterward

I'll attach a stub calendar invite (.ics) with Option B (08:30 PDT / 11:30 EDT / 18:30 CEST) and also include the UTC time in the title (2026-09-17T15:30Z) so calendar clients render both correctly. If you prefer an earlier time (17:30 CEST), I can do that too but would need to hand off some of the closing minutes to Aditya.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (received) — adding our standard M.A.P. to the deal record after the call.

—Kimberly
Senior Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Thanks, that helps a lot. We prefer the earlier side of your suggestion so our execs don't run into late-afternoon conflicts. Can we lock 08:30 PDT / 11:30 EDT / 18:30 CEST on Thu Sep 17? That works for our product lead and gives Berlin a single late hour.

Two asks:
1) Please include explicit UTC in the invite title/body (we've had DST headaches around launch planning).
2) Add our CSM (oakridge-sales@oakridgehealth.com) to the invite and drop the recording link to the HubSpot record after the call.

Michelle
